subject: The difference between parameterEstimates(standardized = T) and standardizedSolution()

messages.author: 17b0cc084223f60e
messages.subject: The difference between parameterEstimates(standardized = T) and standardizedSolution()
parts:
Dear lavaan community,

Can someone explain to me the difference between using parameterEstimates with standardized=T, and using standardizedSolution()? 

In addition, I'm specifically confused about why fixed parameters (such as the factor loading of the first observed variable of a latent variable in the measurement model) have a SE and CI in the output of standardizedSolution(), suggesting that they have become free parameters.

Thank you!
A
